analysis.r1_conclusion: NO_CHANGE. Every tested alternative either degraded the second-order noise texture (11-22% error) or, for sat:3, broke the deterministic global statistics outright. The only verify_signals gain for YCC4/RGB3/speckle2 (5/6 vs 4/6) came from a marginal whole-image variance_ratio threshold flip (a global statistic dominated by saturation/clipping variance, which pair4 shows is content-sensitive by ~9% at the same pipeline), while the direct smooth-region noise texture degraded. Per REFLECTION_MECHANISM judgement priority: no MATCH was achievable (FWHM mismatch is intrinsic to noise-before-blur) and no coherent signal improvement was found -> keep R0.
